title: Strict scalar square and uncancelled completed coordinates
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E,L of Q_ell and an algebra homomorphism iota:E→L. Let Z→X→Y be composable scheme morphisms h,f with ell invertible at every point of all three schemes. Let M_i (i:Fin 3) be constructible derived-complete integral E objects on Y, P_i arbitrary flat-term K-flat representatives, and phi_i:Q(P_i)≅M_i. Use the exact strict quotient systems, expression evaluations, recursive substitutions, scalarBeta, scalarLeft, scalarRight and scalarSubstitution of [def-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization-data]. Fix good:GoodExpressions for the E quotient expressions. Write A_s=pullF(tensor(input 0,input 1)) and A_t=tensor(pullF(input 0),pullF(input 1)); write c_D for comparison at D and F_D for coefficientSequenceLimit at D. Assume every E substitution is invertible. Fix any normalized L Roos models rhoX,rhoY and scalar models SX,SY for the prescribed E reconstruction calculi, as in [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], and goodL for all strict expressions on scalarQuotients(P). Write beta_A for scalarBeta, b_s for scalarSubstitution(SX,strictValue_E(A_s),substitution_E(A_s)), and T_E for the E transport of c_E from A_s to A_t. Then (1) scalarLeft=scalarRight on the first two E quotient inputs; (2) b_s ≫ F_L.map(Q.map(scalarLeft.hom)) = alphaF(M_0 tensor M_1) ≫ pull_L.map(alphaT(M_0,M_1)) ≫ beta_As ≫ F_L.map(Q.map(c_L.hom)); (3) b_s ≫ F_L.map(Q.map(scalarRight.hom)) = scalar_X.map(T_E) ≫ alphaT(pull_E(M_0),pull_E(M_1)) ≫ tensor_L.map(alphaF(M_0),alphaF(M_1)) ≫ beta_At. Here alphaF and alphaT are the fixed integralPullbackScalarComparison and integralTensorScalarComparison of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]; each occurrence uses the exact parentheses and objects in the attached Lean signature. No canonical L comparison identification or invertibility of beta is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the transported strict cochain comparison with the generator-normalized coefficient comparison using the chosen inverse-image equality and uniqueness on generators. The strict scalar square sends b tensor (x tensor y) by either route to (b tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y), compatibly with all quotient transitions.

proof.text: For the left coordinate expand scalarSubstitution, the L source substitution and scalarLeft. Apply the normalized scalar/pullback and scalar/tensor limit squares. Naturality moves the coherent leaf reductions across the strict comparisons, and functoriality of the total-limit functor gives the uncancelled left equation.

proof.text: For the right coordinate expand scalarRight and the E transport. Apply the same two normalized limit squares at X and to the two pulled-back inputs. The inverse E target substitution cancels its forward factor. Counit naturality identifies the remaining factors with scalarBeta at the L target, giving the right equation without cancelling that L factor.

theorem completedScalarRouteCoordinates
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (M : Fin 3 → sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (P : Fin 3 → (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (φ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (P i).obj ≅ (M i).obj)
    (good : GoodExpressions l E h f P)
    (invertible : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
      IsIso (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good A))
    (ρX : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L X) (ρY : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L Y)
    (SX : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E L ι X (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X) ρX)
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E L ι Y (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y) ρY)
    (goodL : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
      StrictQuotient.SystemGood l L (strictValue l L (scalarQuotients l E L ι P) A)) :
    (scalarLeft l E L ι f (quotient l E (P 0).obj) (quotient l E (P 1).obj) =
      scalarRight l E L ι f (quotient l E (P 0).obj) (quotient l E (P 1).obj)) ∧
    (scalarSubstitution l E L ι SX
        (strictValue l E (fun i ↦ quotient l E (P i).obj) (sourceExpression h f))
        (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good (sourceExpression h f)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l L X).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (scalarLeft l E L ι f (quotient l E (P 0).obj)
          (quotient l E (P 1).obj)).hom) =
    (integralPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f
        ((constructibleIntegralTensor l E Y).obj (M 0, M 1))).hom.hom ≫
      (integralDerivedPullback l L f).map
        (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι Y (M 0) (M 1)).hom.hom ≫
      scalarBeta l E L ι M P φ good SY goodL (sourceExpression h f) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l L X).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (comparison l L f ((scalarQuotients l E L ι P) 0)
          ((scalarQuotients l E L ι P) 1)).hom)) ∧
    (scalarSubstitution l E L ι SX
        (strictValue l E (fun i ↦ quotient l E (P i).obj) (sourceExpression h f))
        (substitution l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good (sourceExpression h f)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l L X).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (scalarRight l E L ι f (quotient l E (P 0).obj)
          (quotient l E (P 1).obj)).hom) =
    (integralScalarExtension l E L ι X).map
      (transport l E P (fun i ↦ (M i).obj) φ good invertible
        (sourceExpression h f) (targetExpression h f)
        (comparison l E f (quotient l E (P 0).obj) (quotient l E (P 1).obj)).hom) ≫
      (integralTensorScalarComparison l E L ι X
        ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj (M 0))
        ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj (M 1))).hom.hom ≫
      (integralCompletedTensor l L X).map (Prod.mkHom
        (integralPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f (M 0)).hom.hom
        (integralPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f (M 1)).hom.hom) ≫
      scalarBeta l E L ι M P φ good SY goodL (targetExpression h f))
